title: Regional population and demography
description: Population on 1 January by NUTS 3 region and 5-year age group, median age and the yearly series used for growth (2021–2025, compared on today’s 2024 NUTS borders).

title: Regional GDP
description: Gross domestic product at current market prices by NUTS 3 region, in euros and in purchasing power standards per inhabitant. Gold is GDP.

title: Regional employment and value added by industry
description: Employed persons and gross value added by NUTS 3 region and NACE A*10 industry group (place of work). Food, Production, Science and Culture count jobs in these groups. Germany, Austria, Spain and Poland publish only wider groups (G-J, K-N, O-U) at NUTS 3; these are split with the mix of the parent NUTS 2 region.

title: Area by NUTS 3 region
description: Land area used for population density.

title: Household income by NUTS 2 region
description: Net disposable income of private households per inhabitant (EUR and PPS).

title: Labour Force Survey, regional
description: Unemployment rate, educational attainment of adults 25–64 and population by country of birth, NUTS 2 regions.

title: Life expectancy by NUTS 2 region
description: Life expectancy at birth.

title: Poverty or social exclusion (EU-SILC)
description: Share of people at risk of poverty or social exclusion (AROPE) by NUTS 2 region (some countries only NUTS 1).

title: Digital economy and society, regional
description: Households with broadband (latest regional year, 2021).

title: Tourism: nights spent, regional
description: Nights spent at tourist accommodation, NUTS 2.

title: R&D expenditure by NUTS 2 region
description: GERD as % of GDP.

title: High-tech employment by NUTS 2 region
description: Employment in high-technology sectors.

title: Structural business statistics by NUTS 2 region
description: Persons employed in local units by NACE division (2 digits). The source of city districts and badges (Motor city, Chip city, Finance city…).

title: Population and Housing Census 2021
description: Employed residents by occupation (ISCO-08, NUTS 2) and residents by country of birth (NUTS 3).

title: Metropolitan regions
description: Metro regions (agglomerations of 250,000+ people made of NUTS 3 regions) are the map’s cities. Membership comes from Eurostat’s 2016 metro-region file, carried to 2024 NUTS codes by area overlap (Norway’s Stavanger and Trondheim follow Eurostat’s current list); a few metros redrawn since (Brussels, Lisbon, Riga, Oslo, Cagliari, Charleroi, Liège) differ by more than 8% from Eurostat’s current metro population. Türkiye, Serbia, North Macedonia, Montenegro, Albania, Iceland and Liechtenstein have no Eurostat metro regions: there a city is a NUTS 3 region holding a Natural Earth place of 250,000+ people or the capital. Leuven and Edessa are added as towns. These single-place cities show the population of the municipality itself (Eurostat GISCO LAU; Natural Earth’s city-proper estimate where GISCO has none), not of their NUTS 3 region, and their jobs and GDP are the region’s scaled by that population share; in Türkiye the 30 metropolitan municipalities cover their whole province, so the province is the city.

title: Maritime transport: goods handled in main ports
description: Gross weight of goods handled per port.

title: Air transport: passengers by airport
description: Passengers carried per reporting airport.

title: Regional gross domestic product: all ITL regions
description: UK population (mid-year) and GDP at current market prices by ITL 3 region, 1998 to 2024. Eurostat stopped publishing UK regional figures after Brexit. Regions redrawn in ITL 2025 use the 1998 to 2022 release, carried forward with their ITL 1 region’s growth. Pounds are converted at the year’s average euro rate (Eurostat ert_bil_eur_a).

title: Business Register and Employment Survey (BRES)
publisher: Office for National Statistics, via Nomis
description: Employment by SIC 2007 division on ITL 3 (2021) regions, Great Britain. Northern Ireland is not covered.
used_for: UK Food, Production, Science, Culture yields

title: National accounts and Labour Force Survey by industry
description: Value added and employment by industry for whole countries. Used where a country publishes no regional jobs (Switzerland, Türkiye, Albania, Montenegro): a region’s jobs in an industry are its value added there ÷ the country’s value added per worker, scaled to the national total. Iceland and Liechtenstein have no regional accounts, so their national GDP and jobs are split by population.

title: Local administrative units (LAU) with population
description: Municipality boundaries and populations (2021–2024), used for the population of towns and of cities outside Eurostat’s metro regions.

title: NUTS 2024 boundaries (Nuts2json)
description: NUTS 3 regions (1:10 million) in ETRS89-LAEA (EPSG:3035), the projection of this map, plus country outlines for land and foreign land. The UK, no longer in NUTS 2024, uses its NUTS 2021 regions (identical to ITL 2021). Svalbard, Jan Mayen and the EU’s outermost regions are left off.

title: ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200
description: Land cover read from the cloud-optimised GeoTIFF overviews (about 300 m), sampled every 4 km.

title: Terrain Tiles (Terrarium)
license: Various open (SRTM, EU-DEM, GMTED, ETOPO1); see attribution
description: Elevation at zoom 7 (about 800 m in Europe), sampled every 4 km: hills, mountains, peaks, snow, sea depth.

title: Natural Earth 1:10m
description: Rivers, lakes, populated places (city positions), roads and railroads.

title: Natural Earth roads and railroads
description: Motorways, major highways and railroads, snapped to hex links.

title: Global Power Plant Database v1.3
description: Power plants with capacity, fuel and position. Last updated 2021, so some coal plants shown have since closed and newer wind and solar farms are missing.

title: UNESCO World Heritage List
license: UNESCO terms (data via a public CSV extract)
description: Site names, categories, inscription years and positions; the wonders are picked by inscription order.

title: UN/LOCODE
description: Port positions.

title: OurAirports
description: Airport positions and names by ICAO code.
